name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: 'Carry the box to the exit' needs Existence(at_exit) plus Response(at_exit, holding_box). A bare hard Existence(at_exit) alone lets the agent reach the exit without holding the box, and no other clause closes holding_box after at_exit, so the carrying requirement is dropped. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box); keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box).

texts: Carry the box to the exit
Reach the exit with the box in your hands
If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move
